summary: A builder in {place} still lacks supplies after other businesses begin receiving theirs again.
realLife: Contacts reported that some Chinese supply connections had resumed and firms could use stocks or alternatives, while builders in some US districts still reported disruption.
gates: The record identifies the sector-specific delivery reports and outstanding order.
inGame: needs: sector-specific delivery reports and outstanding order.

turns.what: Their orders proceed while the builder waits.
turns.writesBack: Different delivery dates in the two sector reports.

turns.what: The construction delay can be revised.
turns.pulledBy: The builder secures the missing materials
turns.writesBack: Revised material receipt date on the building schedule.
